headline: Proposed single-family home at 384 Butman Road denied on 3-3 vote
summary: Malane Construction, LLC asked for relief from lot area and frontage rules to build a three-bedroom home on a 5,500-square-foot lot, where 10,000 square feet is the requirement. Neighbors who spoke opposed the project, citing traffic, parking, and drainage. Members also approved illuminated signs at 2 Prince Ave with conditions, and approved an addition at 65 Garden Road with a runoff condition. The sign request for 524 Chelmsford Street was continued to January 11, 2027.
decisions: Motion to approve the variance for a home at 384 Butman Road failed 3-3, so the request was denied.
Approved illuminated signs at 2 Prince Ave with conditions, 6-0.
Approved an addition at 65 Garden Road with a condition that it add no runoff to neighboring properties, 6-0.
Continued the sign request for 524 Chelmsford Street to January 11, 2027.
discussion: 384 Butman Road variance: Neighbors opposed the home, citing traffic, parking, and drainage on the narrow street. The applicant's lawyer argued the new state housing standard applies and that the hardship was not self-created, and members debated the lot size before the 3-3 vote.

Signs at 2 Prince Ave: The applicant asked for 24-hour illumination so emergency crews can find the site. Members added an 8:00 p.m. limit on the large wall sign after one speaker urged denial and said residents were tired of Markley Group appearing before boards.

65 Garden Road addition: Neighbors said the addition would worsen flooding and exceed the floor area limit. The applicant's team said the 2023 basement work was not the cause, and members approved it with a runoff condition.
